Overall a great app at a fair price. One time payment for a ton of tabs and features. Totally worth the $5 (at the time I purchased). I have hundreds of tabs (maybe even more than a thousand at this point). I don’t play gigs so I use the set list feature to separate songs I’m good with by genre and have a couple more lists for ones I’m working on. Very pleased. It does lag a bit when exiting one tab and opening another. This didn’t warrant losing a whole star though. I never use the YouTube feature. I’ve tried a couple times and the videos were usually taken off YouTube already. Regardless, a great easy to use app for any guitarist - from busker to luthier.

Edit: I now do play some (free) gigs and, man, this app is tremendous. I learned, though, to back up my local edits before updating. Although, with this last update, it let me bring in my old edits. You have to hunt a bit in your profile to figure out how to do that.

Another edit: still loving the app but one weird thing now… after recent updates, my scroll settings reset for every song. That means I have to go back through all my favorites songs and set each one manually. Not a dealbreaker, but definitely the inconsistency is inconvenient for sure. Regardless, I’m very happy with my initial $5. I’ve easily made that back in both enjoyment and tips during performances.

Love this app. Disclaimer: I'm a beginner and mostly self taught with the help of books. That said, this app works very well for me. It saves me from having to search google for free tabs, and has a solid variety of songs as long as they're not extremely recent, since most seem to be from contributors/other app users. And most songs have multiple versions--for example, for a single song there may be 1 containing bare chords, maybe 2 or 3 with complete tabs, and one with sheet music &tab(these are labeled "guitar pro" in the app. The others are clearly labeled as "chords" or "tab"). Depending on the song popularity there may be 9 or more versions. It's not a problem finding the one you were studying thanks to the history and favorites features. I don't need an in app tuner or recording capabilities--I use this app to find tabs and for that it's fantastic. Well organized, easy to navigate, good search options. Aesthetics aren't great, but that doesn't really matter to me.
